gate_plan.name: reachable deployment
gate_plan.evidence: Streamlit app reachable after merge and reboot

gate_plan.name: fixed-24m OOS anchors
gate_plan.action: Provide verified chronological 6/12/18/24 anchor evidence with timestamps and methodology

gate_plan.name: baseline metrics
gate_plan.action: Compute documented baseline metrics and comparison thresholds using production data

gate_plan.name: provenance and settled evidence
gate_plan.action: Attach lineage, model/version identifiers, finalized snapshots, and reproducible audit trails

gate_plan.name: live rollback drill
gate_plan.action: Execute in staging or production, record success criteria and post-drill validation

gate_plan.name: key custody policy
gate_plan.action: Document roles, access controls, rotation, recovery, and audit requirements

gate_plan.name: human sign-off
gate_plan.action: Model Risk, Compliance, and Suitability reviewers sign the packet

blockers: Gates 2-4 require verified external market data and cannot be fabricated by AI
Gate 7 requires human reviewer availability and approval
